text: Carbon Robotics - About the company Carbon Robotics is a series D company based in Seattle (United States), founded in 2018. It operates as an AI-powered laser weeding solutions for sustainable and profitable agriculture. Carbon Robotics has raised $276M in funding from investors like Voyager Capital, Bolt and Anthos Capital, with a current valuation of $*****. The company has 17 active competitors, including 4 that are funded. Its top competitors include companies like Terra Robotics, Harvested Robotics and Weed Bot Europe. Company Details AI-powered laser weeding solutions for sustainable and profitable agriculture. This company pioneers AI robotics for farming, offering a dependable tractor autonomy solution. They specialize in precise weed control through their LaserWeeder products, which utilize computer vision, deep learning, and robotics to target and eliminate weeds with lasers. This innovative approach reduces costs, increases yield and quality, and eliminates the need for hand labor, herbicides, and mechanical cultivation. Their technology promotes soil health and stronger crops. They offer 24/7 remote support and training materials, empowering growers with self-sufficiency. The company is committed to engineering an AgTech revolution, providing solutions for a wide range of farms, crops, and soil types.
